title: Wholesale Sample-to-Order Workflows for Nutrition Brands Using HubSpot and NetSuite
summary: Route nutrition sample requests from HubSpot through approval, NetSuite fulfillment evidence and Slack prompts, so reps follow up on what shipped.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A sample-to-order workflow should link the requested nutrition products, approved recipient, fulfillment evidence, and later wholesale opportunity. Use explicit sample authorization and keep the first paid order’s account approval separate. This gives sales an accurate follow-up trail without representing every sample shipment as a commercial sale.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
